test_title: PYST 3 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 13 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the following sentence parts to form a meaningful and grammatically correct paragraph:

P. The method, which is titled the Socratic method, is a cornerstone of Western philosophy.

Q. Socrates believed that the path to knowledge was not through lecturing but through a systematic process of questioning.

R. He would probe his students mercilessly, taking them through a chain of logical conclusions.

S. Its goal was not to provide answers but to force the individual to discover the truth for themselves.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Q, P, R, S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The paragraph revolves around explaining the Socratic method, a systematic process of questioning for discovering truth.
 
• Statement Q introduces the belief of Socrates, which forms the foundation of the Socratic method.
 
• Statement P names the method and highlights its importance in Western philosophy.
 
• Statement R describes how Socrates conducted his questioning process with his students.
 
• Statement S concludes by explaining the ultimate goal of the method.

Correct sequence: *Q, P, R, S*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Logical Flow:** The paragraph must begin with the introduction of Socrates' belief (Q), followed by identifying the method (P), describing the process (R), and concluding with its purpose (S).
 
• **Elimination of Options:**
 
 
• Option 2 (S, P, R, Q) disrupts the logical order by starting with the conclusion.
 
• Option 3 (Q, R, S, P) misplaces the naming of the method after the description of its process.
 
• Option 4 (S, Q, R, P) incorrectly begins with the conclusion and places the introduction later.
